facts.text: Under the Minnesota Tuition Guarantee, NCU covers remaining tuition costs in fall and spring terms after state and federal aid are applied for eligible students.

sources.title: Scholarships & Types of Financial Aid | NCU - North Central University
sources.quote: The Minnesota Tuition Guarantee ensures that NCU will cover any remaining tuition costs in the Fall and Spring terms after state and federal financial aid are applied, for students who meet the eligibility requirements.

facts.text: The Regent's Tuition Scholarship is a four-year, full-tuition scholarship awarded to one first-time freshman annually based on academic performance, leadership, references, and an essay.

sources.title: Scholarships & Types of Financial Aid | NCU - North Central University
sources.quote: The Regent's Tuition Scholarship is a four-year, full-tuition scholarship awarded to one first-time freshmen student each year based on superior academic performance and leadership/extracurricular experience, two references, and a written essay.
